snippet.title: The Supreme Chicken - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
THE SUPREME CHICKEN IS NOW AVAILABLE ON ITCH IO!

A huge thank you to everyone who supported this tiny, silly indie project. The game is finally complete and available for all. 🍗

Cover song made by: @ONLAP
